name: Empty state
description: A message shown where content would be but isn't yet, such as an empty list or a search with no results. It says why the area is empty and offers the next step.
summary: Explains missing content and offers a next step
htmlElement: <div> with a heading, text and an action

elements.name: Illustration
elements.description: Icon or image; decorative, so hidden from screen readers

elements.name: Heading
elements.description: Says what is empty, e.g. "No projects yet"

elements.name: Description
elements.description: Why it is empty or what will appear here

elements.name: Action
elements.description: Button or Link for the next step, such as creating an item or clearing filters

configOptions.options: Compact (inside a Card or Table), Full area

variants.caption: Full area — illustration, text and action
Start aligned — icon beside the text

usageNotes: Say what is empty and what to do next. A bare "No data" leaves people guessing whether something failed.
Treat the illustration as decorative (aria-hidden="true" or an empty alt); the heading and text carry the message.
When it replaces results after a search or filter change, announce it in a role="status" region so screen reader users know the update happened (WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages).
Pick the heading level from where it sits in the outline, not from the size you want (see Heading).
Use Empty state for missing content. Use Alert for errors that need attention, and Skeleton or Spinner while content is still loading.
